title: Decision-Focused Reinforcement Learning for LLM Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.25597v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise as predictors across various tasks, benefiting from their ability to use information from unstructured context. However, when predictions serve as parameters of downstream optimization problems, higher prediction accuracy does not necessarily translate into lower decision costs. We propose decision-focused reinforcement learning (DFRL), a framework for post-training LLMs to predict optimization parameters using negative downstream decision regret as reward. DFRL trains LLM predictors to minimize the costs of the decisions induced by their predictions, without requiring downstream convexity or differentiability, and integrates readily into existing RL post-training frameworks. To address expensive reward evaluation, we develop two approaches. translated_title: 面向决策的强化学习用于大语言模型后训练
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）作为各类任务中的预测器展现出了巨大潜力，这得益于它们利用非结构化上下文信息的能力。然而，当预测结果作为下游优化问题的参数时，更高的预测精度并不一定转化为更低的决策成本。我们提出了面向决策的强化学习（DFRL），这是一个用于对LLM进行后训练以预测优化参数的框架，它采用下游决策的负遗憾作为奖励。DFRL训练LLM预测器以最小化由其预测所导致的决策成本，无需下游问题具有凸性或可微性，并且能够轻松集成到现有的强化学习后训练框架中。为了解决奖励评估开销高昂的问题，我们开发了两种方法。启发式热启动在初始阶段使用廉价的近似奖励，随后切换为使用精确奖励进行改进。奖励校正……（原文截断）
tldr: 该论文提出面向决策的强化学习（DFRL）框架，以下游决策负遗憾作为奖励对LLM进行后训练，使其预测直接最小化下游决策成本且无需下游问题凸性或可微性，并通过启发式热启动和奖励校正两种方法解决了奖励评估开销大的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Decision-Focused Reinforcement Learning (DFRL), a post-training framework that uses negative downstream decision regret as reward to train LLMs to predict optimization parameters that directly minimize decision costs without requiring downstream convexity or differentiability, while addressing expensive reward evaluation through heuristic warm-starting and reward correction.
